summary.excluded: Long-standing skipped directions; optimization-lab and arena; tests/fixtures; auth/permission/security/custody/identity/sandbox; obvious native/UI/network/account references; and existing focused diff/parser families. Regex exclusion is a conservative proposal filter, not semantic safety validation.
limits: Only explicit path+SHA and coverage/ranges in source-manifest-named JSON are extracted. Other prose, source-check receipts and unstructured claims are not credited.
Full is accepted only for a small explicit-label allowlist. Selected unions remain selected even if combined line ranges cover the whole file.
Rows with no read scope remain pin-only; hashes never imply semantic reading. Duplicate/copied claim variants do not count as independent audits.
Old/full read claims stay prior-version-only when their pinned SHA differs; a row newer currentSha256 cannot replace its frozen/read SHA.
This scan verifies metadata shape and current byte identity, not old authors' coverage honesty, semantic exhaustion, test correctness or repository completion.
No product/module import, AST/VM/eval, test/helper function, Git, native/model/network/HOME/account execution.
